title: Recording: Picasso’s Last Words (Drink To Me) by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio One, AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

Wings recorded overdubs for the Band On The Run song ‘Picasso’s Last Words (Drink To Me)’ on 11 October 1973.

The backing track had been recorded in Lagos on 17 September. On this day Paul McCartney re-recorded the drums, which were considered too ragged for release, along with other overdubs. The song was completed on 12 and 28 October.

We added a lot of overdubs later when we returned to London, editing them together, along with snatches of other tunes on the album, to try to make one cohesive piece out of it.
Geoff Emerick
Here, There and Everywhere: My Life Recording The Music Of The Beatles
